overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run detects where bias mechanisms occur very well, but exact construct identification is materially weaker. The 0.2857 F1 gap between mechanism-first and strict scoring is driven by two localized findings with full mechanism overlap but non-equivalent labels; two other near-neighbor predictions also miss the target reasoning operation. All findings are high confidence, so threshold choice does not alter results. This is a single-run record and supports no dataset-level or system-ranking inference.
